items.title: What the Heck is Graph Engineering?
items.summary: OpenAI says it cannot rule out that its next model, Astra, has critical cyber capabilities — and actually pauses the release, the first big real-world test of a frontier lab's safety commitments. items.title: Lovable’s answer to enterprise AI risk is an insurance policy from Lloyd’s
items.summary:
